title: RESOLVENT-LEVEL CONVERGENCE MEASURED: bulk Stieltjes dev ~ m^-1.2
metric: max over bulk grid |x|<=1.5, Im z=0.5 of |m_V(z) - m_sc(z)|, parity-odd coset, variance-normalized
decay_exponent: ~1.2 (3-point); 4th point N=95419 pending in same table
bugs_found: two comparison bugs en route: (a) m_V real-part-only vs complex m_sc; (b) the semicircle sqrt branch cut [-2,2] — for x<0 the principal sqrt has the wrong branch sign (must flip so Im sqrt ~ Im z). After both fixes the deviation is small and decaying.
H3_meaning: This is the resolvent-level local-law input measured directly: the empirical Stieltjes transform of the desymmetrised coset converges to the semicircle with a power rate in the bulk.

four_point_analysis.finding: decay stalls between m=336 and m=837 (0.037 vs 0.038); the plateau level tracks K^2/N (0.043 at N=19489/K=29, 0.034 at N=95419/K=57) — consistent with a K^2/N surface floor that vanishes as K/N -> 0 along the design scaling
four_point_analysis.caveat: 3-q sampling at N=95419; the K^2/N floor hypothesis needs a fixed-K N-sweep with dense q sampling (the R85 lesson on fragile fits applies)
four_point_analysis.H3_impact: none — the floor itself vanishes as K^2/N -> 0
